entities.summary: Andríy Kóbolyev is a Ukrainian politician and businessman, and the former chief executive officer of Ukrainian largest company, the state-owned oil and gas company Naftogaz. In October 2014, Kobolyev was named a global "Top 40 under 40" leader by Fortune in recognition of his anti-corruption reform successes.
